summary: Integrate small neural and behavioral datasets with explicit alignment, provenance and hypothesis-driven model comparison.
outcomes: Deliver a semantically valid multimodal dataset subset and analysis.
Distinguish added predictive information from confounding or timing artifacts.
sequence: Choose an openly reusable multimodal study subset
Audit identifiers, clocks and coordinate frames
Fit neural, behavioral and combined baselines
Evaluate grouped generalization and negative controls
Report data limitations and reproducible provenance

visual.question: Did the new modality add information or reveal a confound?
visual.interaction: Toggle modalities and controlled time shifts while preserving split boundaries.

practice.task: Build the data package, baseline comparison and audit report.
practice.success: Includes alignment error, schema checks, license, uncertainty and a documented negative control.
